benchmark: CORD v2 receipt OCR and line-grouping baseline
parser: parse_pdf_document with positioned OCR; no receipt-specific grouping model

definitions.line_reference: CORD valid_line entries; word quadrilaterals are enveloped into axis-aligned boxes
definitions.cer: whitespace-normalized CER after IoU >= 0.50 spatial matching; unmatched line text counted as insertions/deletions
definitions.grouping: recall of annotation-defined lines recovered as OCR text blocks at IoU >= 0.50; group_id/row_id semantic assignment is not predicted and is not scored
definitions.annotation_caveat: CORD valid_line is the selected line annotation; OCR detections without a matched valid_line are counted as insertions, including detections on content excluded from valid_line.
